setup.85fb2e4e23: 请确认连接配置后保存。
setup.9b8e58bc4b: Scan complete. Select a network or enter its name.
扫描完成，可从网络名称列表选择或手动输入。
setup.21e341916d: Scan timed out. Retry or enter the network name.
扫描超时，请重试或手动输入。
setup.10bfe8eea2: Connect to the device and read its status first.
请先连接设备并读取状态。
setup.5a5f5ab562: Use 8–32 printable ASCII characters for the web password.
网页密码需要 8 至 32 位可打印 ASCII 字符。
setup.3a2a307ad0: Settings are too long. Check network names and passwords.
配置内容过长，请检查网络名称和密码。
setup.064a97c4bf: Wi-Fi passwords must be at least 8 bytes.
Wi-Fi 密码至少需要 8 字节。
setup.ae49332c8b: 正在保存 MQTT 配置…
setup.5ea9986202: 正在保存网页管理密码…
setup.340b70ed88: MQTT 配置已保存，正在试连 Wi-Fi…
setup.673c7d6bfe: Settings saved. Wi-Fi is being tested. If the hotspot disconnects, reconnect to your LAN and check Wi-Fi and MQTT at the device address.
配置已保存，Wi-Fi 正在试连。热点断开后请切回内网，再用设备地址确认 Wi-Fi 和 MQTT 实际连接状态。
setup.6bf4396e1e: MQTT settings saved; Wi-Fi is not yet confirmed. Reconnect and check status. A failed trial restores the previous network.
MQTT 配置已保存，Wi-Fi 试连结果尚未确认。请重新连接设备查看状态；试连失败会恢复原 Wi-Fi。
setup.fbc2acb09e: Reopen setup from the management platform.
请从管理平台重新打开配置
setup.b8f77a99a1: The provisioning link is invalid. Enter settings manually or reopen it from the platform.
平台配置链接已失效，请手动填写或从平台重新打开。
setup.d53e51f858: Platform settings filled in. Save and connect to apply them.
平台配置已填入，点击保存并连接后生效。
setup.344bb96da6: Platform settings are invalid. Enter them manually.
平台配置无效，请手动填写。
setup.31afde9ba7: Device status is unavailable. Check the connection and refresh.
暂时无法读取设备状态，请确认连接后刷新。
setup.title: {m} device setup
{m} 设备设置
setup.import: 来自管理平台的 MQTT 配置
setup.import_hint: Confirm to fill the form. Save to apply settings.
确认后填入下方表单，点击保存才会应用。
setup.order: Settings are saved before switching Wi-Fi. You can edit them here if the connection fails.
配置将先保存，再切换 Wi-Fi。连接失败时仍可在本页修改。
setup.wifi_hint: Wi-Fi is tested for 30 seconds. A failed trial restores the previous network. After success, reconnect your phone to the same LAN.
设备会试连 30 秒，失败后恢复原 Wi-Fi。成功后热点可能关闭，请将手机切回同一内网。
setup.new_password: 新密码（选填，留空不修改）
setup.auth_hint: The username is admin. This password is independent of MQTT.
用户名为 admin。此密码与 MQTT 密码独立。
setup.device_language: 设备语言（用于 MQTT 名称）
setup.platform: Use IotCloud for full device controls. Setup works at both the device hotspot and LAN address.
完整设备控制请使用 IotCloud 管理平台。此页在设备热点及内网地址下均可访问。
setup.resetting: Clear request accepted. Waiting for restart; reconnect to the device hotspot if disconnected.
清空请求已接受，等待设备重启；连接断开后请重新连接设备热点。
recovery.ready: Configuration cleared. You can set up the device again.
配置已清空，可以重新配网。
recovery.unconfirmed: The device restarted but still requires configuration recovery. Clearing was not confirmed; reconnect and try again.
设备已重启，但仍需恢复配置。清空结果未确认，请重新连接后重试。
recovery.hint: The saved configuration cannot be migrated. Original data is retained. Confirm clearing it to configure the device again.
原配置无法迁移，原始数据已保留。请明确确认清空后重新配网。
recovery.clear: Clear configuration and set up again
recovery.confirm: Clear all saved settings, including Wi-Fi and MQTT credentials? This cannot be undone.
清空包括 Wi-Fi、MQTT 密码在内的所有配置？此操作无法撤销。
error.migration_required: Clear the incompatible configuration before setting up again
请先确认清空不兼容配置，再重新设置
